rationale: I read the complete held EO 12314 (46 FR 38329, July 22, 1981, Federal Regional Councils): sec. 1 restructures a Federal Regional Council for each of ten standard regions with named agency members, sec. 2 sets council functions, sec. 3 gives OMB oversight, and sec. 4(b) revokes EO 12149. It has no own term, sunset or savings clause. I read the complete held EO 12407 (48 FR 7717, Feb. 22, 1983): its whole operative text is 'in order to eliminate a mechanism for interagency and intergovernmental coordination which is no longer needed, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 12314, establishing the Federal Regional Councils, is revoked.' That revokes the whole order by number, unconditionally and with no savings clause, so every part of EO 12314 ended on Feb. 22, 1983 (or on publication, Feb. 24, 1983). D6 self-check: the only later event in the history is EO 12407. No other held instrument names EO 12314 (the only hit in the held texts for the number is EO 12407). Nothing amended EO 12314 before the revocation, no own term ran out earlier, and EO 12407 does not restore EO 12149, which EO 12314 had revoked. Catalog 'Revoked by: EO 12407' and the 1989 snapshot agree and are leads only. Provisional NO hypothesis.
